name: Vertebrate Zoology & Comparative Anatomy
summary: The evolution, form and diversity of vertebrates, from jawless fishes to mammals, with comparative anatomy of their organ systems.

topics.name: Chordate origins and the vertebrate body plan
Jawless fishes and the origin of jaws
The transition to land: tetrapod origins and amphibians
The amniotic egg; reptiles including turtles and crocodilians
Dinosaurs and the evolution of birds and flight (ornithology)
Comparative anatomy: nervous, circulatory, respiratory and digestive systems
Vertebrate life histories and reproductive strategies
